# Funding Rounds Tracker: SEC Form D, Form C, Funding News & Investor Portfolios

Private-company funding data is scattered across SEC filings, press releases and VC websites. This actor brings the three together into one dataset: funding-round records with company, stage, amount, dates, backers and source documents, plus investor profiles built from live portfolio and team pages. Every source is public and cookieless — no API key, login or proxy setup is required.

## What this actor does

- **`searchRounds`** — funded companies in a date window, with filters for round type, amount, country, US state, industry and keyword.
- **`companyLookup`** — every SEC Form D/C round plus recent funding news for a company name, domain or Crunchbase URL.
- **`investorLookup`** — VC firm or angel profiles. Six firms in the built-in directory also get live portfolio companies and team members; every investor gets deal statistics from the rounds observed in the same run.
- **`monitor`** — remembers round identities in a key-value store and emits only rounds that were not seen in earlier runs.

Sources:

- **SEC EDGAR Form D and D/A** — full-text search plus each filing's `primary_doc.xml`: issuer, CIK, entity type, jurisdiction, industry group, offering amount, amount sold, amount remaining, investor count, minimum investment, exemptions (506(b), 506(c), 4(a)(5), etc.), sales commissions and related executives, directors and promoters.
- **SEC EDGAR Form C and C/A** — Regulation Crowdfunding offerings: issuer website, security type, offering amount, maximum offering, deadline, employee count and recent revenue/net income.
- **Funding newswires** — PR Newswire's general, financial-services and venture-capital RSS feeds, plus Google News funding queries that index GlobeNewswire, Business Wire, AccessWire and hundreds of outlets. Round type, amount, currency, lead and participating investors are parsed from each headline.
- **Investor websites** — General Catalyst, Accel, Felicis, Greylock, Union Square Ventures and Founders Fund portfolio and team pages. Other firms and angels are still profiled from their observed deals.

Rounds are de-duplicated across Form D, Form C and news. A Form D amendment is folded into its original offering, and several news reports of one round become one record with all source links.

## Output per round

Every round record has `recordType: "round"` and these fields when the source publishes them:

- `companyName`, `domain`, `cik`
- `roundType` — `preSeed`, `preSeriesA`, `seed`, `seriesA` … `seriesG`, `growth`, `privateEquity`, `debt`, `convertibleNote`, `crowdfunding`, `ipo` or `undisclosed`
- `amount`, `currency`, `amountUsd`, `amountBasis`
- `announcedDate`, `filedDate`
- `leadInvestors[]`, `investors[]`
- `country`, `state`, `city`, `industry`
- **Form D details:** `offeringAmount`, `amountSold`, `amountRemaining`, `investorCount`, `hasNonAccreditedInvestors`, `minimumInvestment`, `securityType`, `exemptions[]`, `entityType`, `jurisdiction`, `yearFounded`, `revenueRange`, `relatedPersons[]`, `salesAgents[]`, `salesCommissions`, `findersFees`, `grossProceedsUsed`, `salesCompensationNotes`, `signatureDate`, `isAmendment`, `amendmentCount`, `firstFiledDate`
- **Form C details:** `website`, `maximumOfferingAmount`, `securityType`, `securitiesOffered`, `pricePerSecurity`, `offeringDeadline`, `employeeCount`, `revenueMostRecentFiscalYear`, `netIncomeMostRecentFiscalYear`, `signers[]`
- `filingUrl`, `documentUrl`, `sourceUrl`, `sourceName`, `sourceType`, `sources[]`, `confidence`
- `recordType`, `scrapedAt`

## Output per investor

Every investor record has `recordType: "investor"`:

- `investorName`, `investorType`, `website`
- `hqLocation`, `hqCity`, `hqCountry`
- `portfolioUrl`, `teamUrl`
- `partners[]` — name, title and profile URL from the live team page
- `portfolioCompanies[]` — name and URL from the live portfolio page
- `partnerCount`, `portfolioCount`
- `dealCount`, `stages[]`, `sectors[]`, `geographies[]`, `lastDealDate`, `recentDeals[]`
- `sources[]`, `recordType`, `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchRounds` | `searchRounds`, `companyLookup`, `investorLookup` or `monitor` |
| `includeSecFormD` | boolean | `true` | Query SEC Form D/D/A filings |
| `includeSecFormC` | boolean | `true` | Query SEC Form C/C-A crowdfunding filings |
| `includeNews` | boolean | `true` | Read funding newswires and Google News |
| `lookbackDays` | integer | `30` | Days back from today when `fromDate` is empty |
| `fromDate` | string | – | Start date `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `toDate` | string | – | End date `YYYY-MM-DD` (defaults to today) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–500) |
| `searchQuery` | string | – | Free-text filter and source query |
| `roundType` | string | Any round type | Keep one stage |
| `minAmount` | integer | – | Minimum USD amount |
| `maxAmount` | integer | – | Maximum USD amount |
| `country` | string | – | Country name or alias |
| `state` | string | Any state | US state code |
| `industry` | string | Any industry | Inferred industry |
| `sortBy` | string | `newest` | `newest`, `oldest` or `largestAmount` |
| `companies` | array | – | Names, domains or Crunchbase URLs (max 20) |
| `maxRoundsPerCompany` | integer | `10` | Rounds per company in `companyLookup` |
| `investors` | array | – | Firm or angel names |
| `investorStage` | string | Any round type | Stage filter for investor profiles |
| `investorSector` | string | Any industry | Sector filter for investor profiles |
| `investorGeography` | string | – | Country or region filter |
| `minDeals` | integer | – | Minimum observed deals |
| `monitorStateKey` | string | `default` | Separate saved state per watchlist |
| `monitorReset` | boolean | `false` | Ignore and replace saved state |
| `includeRelatedPersons` | boolean | `true` | Add Form D executives, directors and promoters |
| `enrichNewsPages` | boolean | `true` | Fetch news article pages for domains and descriptions |

`mode` is the only required field. All other fields have working defaults, and the daily prefill is the smallest run with output: `searchRounds` + SEC Form D + 7-day window + 3 records.

### Example: seed rounds in the United States

```json
{
  "mode": "searchRounds",
  "includeSecFormD": true,
  "includeSecFormC": true,
  "includeNews": true,
  "lookbackDays": 14,
  "roundType": "seed",
  "minAmount": 1000000,
  "country": "United States",
  "maxItems": 25
}
```

### Example: every round for a company

```json
{
  "mode": "companyLookup",
  "companies": ["openai.com", "Anthropic"],
  "maxRoundsPerCompany": 10,
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: an investor profile

```json
{
  "mode": "investorLookup",
  "investors": ["Felicis"],
  "maxItems": 1
}
```

### Example: only new rounds

```json
{
  "mode": "monitor",
  "includeNews": true,
  "lookbackDays": 3,
  "monitorStateKey": "us-seed-watch",
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

## How the merging works

- **Form D amendments:** filings with the same CIK, first-sale date and offering size are one round. The newest amendment wins; `amendmentCount` and `firstFiledDate` preserve the history.
- **Form D + news:** same company, within 75 days, compatible stage and an amount ratio below 2.5x is one round. The SEC filing stays the base record; news adds backers, description, industry and domain.
- **News + news:** same company, within 14 days and a compatible stage/amount is one event reported by several outlets. The newest report wins and all source links are kept in `sources[]`.
- **Monitor:** the identity is company + stage + amount bucket + year-month, so an amendment or a second outlet does not re-alert the same round.

## Limits and notes

- **SEC coverage is US issuers.** Form D is an exempt-offering notice, not a press release. It usually names related persons but not investors, and many filings do not state a Series A/B/C label — those records use `roundType: "undisclosed"`.
- **Form D amount semantics.** `amount` uses the amount sold when the issuer reports one, otherwise the total offering amount. `amountBasis` tells you which one was used; `offeringAmount`, `amountSold` and `amountRemaining` keep all three figures.
- **Non-USD rounds are not converted.** `amount` and `currency` keep the reported currency. `amountUsd` exists only for USD rounds, and the amount filters only compare USD records; other currencies pass through.
- **News coverage is a window, not a complete history.** The feeds expose recent items, and Google News returns at most about 100 results per query. `companyLookup` broadens the window to five years for SEC filings and as far back as Google News allows for news.
- **Investor deal statistics are observed, not lifetime totals.** `dealCount`, `stages`, `sectors` and `geographies` come from the rounds collected in that run. `portfolioCount` is the number of companies on the firm's live portfolio page.
- **GlobeNewswire and AccessWire can answer 403 to datacenter IPs.** The actor logs the status and continues with PR Newswire and Google News, which index both wires. No residential proxy is required.
- **Google News article links are redirect URLs.** They can return an error to command-line clients from some regions even though they open in a browser; direct PR Newswire links are normal article pages. Company domains are filled from Form C websites and direct article pages, not from Google News redirects.
- **SEC fair access.** Requests use a descriptive User-Agent and stay below the SEC's 10 requests/second limit. Filing-XML enrichment is capped at 400 filings per run; raise `maxItems` and use narrower filters for larger jobs.
- **No emails or phone numbers.** The actor does not harvest personal contact details; related-person and partner records contain only names, titles, cities and profile URLs that the source already publishes.

## FAQ

**Why is a round's stage `undisclosed`?**  Most Form D filings do not say "Series A" or "Seed". If a funding article for the same company is found, its stage is merged in; otherwise the record stays honest and says `undisclosed`.

**Why does a Form D show an amount larger than the money raised?**  `amountBasis: "offering"` means the issuer only reported a target. Check `amountSold` for the amount actually sold, or `amountRemaining` for the gap.

**Can I track a specific market?**  Yes. Combine `roundType`, `minAmount`, `country`, `state`, `industry` and `searchQuery`. Records that do not publish a field pass that filter, so you never lose a company just because a source omitted its country.

**How does the monitor avoid duplicate alerts?**  It stores one identity per company/stage/amount/month in the actor's key-value store. Different `monitorStateKey` values keep independent watchlists. Use `monitorReset` once to start over.

**Does it need cookies or an API key?**  No. SEC EDGAR, the newswire RSS feeds and the investor pages are all public. The actor never asks for a login, cookie or proxy.
